_comment: Sibling OPSD on LLaDA2.0-mini / MATH (doc/plan_a_loo_defer.md). Same model, data, prompt and DMax decoding rules as llada2_mini_math.json, but the aggressive threshold tau=0.5 for rollouts and evaluation (Phase 0, job 1118270: at 0.7 sibling conflicts are ~1% and accuracy losses come from other paths; at 0.5 they are 3.7% and cause glitch->truncation failures) (override generation.commit_threshold for the 0.95 reference). The student is base + LoRA (rank 32 on every attention query_key_value and dense); the Teacher is the frozen base with the co-committed siblings revealed (leave-one-out); target t = alpha*onehot(c) + (1-alpha)*q with alpha = max(0, 2*tau - 1) = 0 at tau 0.5 (sibling.alpha_mix=null), every other token capped at tau - cap_margin = 0.49 with the excess spread uniformly (parallel commit <=> q(c) >= 1/2, no redirect). Rollouts: T=0.9, up to 8 attempts, stop at the first verified answer. Base-model evaluations set sibling.lora_rank=0.
